summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (or reuses a local `bun`) and then `execFileSync`s the sibling `math_init.js` under Bun on `npm install`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB `@bun-cjs` bundle whose strings are hidden behind a shuffled-string-array rotator and a per-character alphabet decoder, so its URLs, paths, and commands are not readable from source. The advertised purpose of the package is a React quick-actions UI component library (`dist/index.js` exports React components and hooks); a React component library has no functional need to ship a large obfuscated Bun-executed bundle or to fetch and run an alternate runtime at install time. Fetching a second runtime specifically to execute a sibling obfuscated payload at install is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern and evades Node-only scanning of lifecycle scripts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
